meta.title: Six friends, $1,800
meta.prompt: Six friends are planning a weekend trip with a total budget of $1,800. Each person has different preferences regarding accommodation, transportation, food, and activities, but nobody has fully disclosed their priorities or maximum contribution. Can you moderate the discussion, gather everyone's constraints, and help negotiate a fair budget allocation that all six members can accept?
meta.context: Six friends (Maya, Leo, Sofia, Omar, Priya, Theo) are planning a weekend trip with a total budget of $1,800. Nobody has said what they can contribute or what they need.

own_room.label: needs her own room

events.text: Hi all! We have $1,800 total for the weekend. Options are: Lodging A house with 4 rooms $780 / B 2 hotel rooms + 1 single $690 / C hostel dorm $360. Transport A train $480 / B two rental cars, 5-hour drive $300 / C one van, 5-hour drive $240. Food A restaurants every meal $600 / B cook + 2 dinners out vegetarian-friendly $380 / C cook every meal shared barbecue $220. Activities A guided hike + concert $420 / B concert only $240 / C free trails $0. What are your must-haves, deal-breakers, or max you can contribute? Let's find a combo we all like within budget.
I'm excited about the activities, especially the guided hike and concert. I can contribute up to $450.
Hi Leo! To find a plan we can all afford, could you share your max contribution for the weekend and any must-haves or deal-breakers for lodging, transport, food, or activities?
I can contribute up to $400 and I have no hard constraints, my top priority is transport.
Hi Sofia! To help find a plan we can all afford, could you share your max contribution for the weekend and any must-haves or deal-breakers for lodging, transport, food, or activities?
I can contribute up to $350 and I need my own room, so lodging is my top priority.
Hi Omar! To help find a plan we can all afford, could you share your max contribution for the weekend and any must-haves or deal-breakers for lodging, transport, food, or activities?
I can contribute up to $250 and my top priority is food, I'd really like to have good meals.
Hi Priya! To help find a plan we can all afford, could you share your max contribution for the weekend and any must-haves or deal-breakers for lodging, transport, food, or activities?
I can contribute up to $200 and I'm vegetarian, so food needs to be vegetarian-friendly. My top priority is activities.
Hi Theo! To help find a plan we can all afford, could you share your max contribution for the weekend and any must-haves or deal-breakers for lodging, transport, food, or activities?
I can contribute up to $150 and my top priority is food, I'd love to have restaurants every meal but it's not a must-have. I have no hard constraints.

Plan 1: lodging 2 hotel rooms + 1 single, transport two rental cars, 5-hour drive, food cook + 2 dinners out (vegetarian-friendly), activities guided hike + concert.
Maya pays $440.
Leo pays $400.
Sofia pays $350.
Omar pays $250.
Priya pays $200.
Theo pays $150.
Total $1,790 of $1,800.
